headline: Prime-uniform Witt carry and polynomial-tensor rigidity research
claimBoundary: Two distinct counterexamples are publicly claimed; a recent adversarial manuscript disputes them but presently addresses different groups. This site presents unreviewed prime-uniform proof candidates and claims neither priority nor independently settled final status.

lean.fullBuild: repair patch awaiting CI; two focused targets green

claims.name: Canonical Hopf structure reconstructs the group
claims.evidence: Lean source repaired; standalone dependency build must still pass.

claims.name: Every nonzero first-two-symmetric tensor has infinite SL3(F[t]) orbit
claims.evidence: New formal strengthening of the divided-cube theorem; complete build pending.

claims.name: Stable/critical polynomial tensors have infinite elementary orbit
claims.evidence: Coordinate-block proof covers every tensor degree m<r without symmetry and the critical line m=r under first-two-factor symmetry; only the rank-three instance has Lean source.

claims.name: Divided pth-power cyclicity holds in the stable and odd-critical range
claims.evidence: Fresh-coordinate and antisymmetrized two-source inductions cover r>p and odd r=p over every finite-variable polynomial ring; exact ledgers pass at primes 2, 3, and 5.

claims.name: The ternary divided-cube kernel is cyclic
claims.evidence: Simultaneous-induction proof written; degree-12 oracle matches dimension 2258 and replays a seed-or-identity ledger for every kernel basis vector.

claims.name: Divided-cube cyclicity extends to F3[t_1,...,t_d]
claims.evidence: Two-step finite-difference proof written; bivariate degree-3 orbit is 444/444 and trivariate degree-2 orbit is 304/304.

claims.name: Finite-orbit subgroup of A_n[3]/3A_n has order 3^(3n)
claims.evidence: Exact-sequence proof written; classical higher-rank lattice theorems make A_n the amenable radical. Bockstein construction and formalization remain.

claims.name: Untwisted cubic diagonal over a general characteristic-three field
claims.evidence: Linearity forces lambda^3=lambda for every scalar; the general statement needs a Frobenius twist. The focused Lean module builds against the pinned toolchain.

claims.name: All shifts have common von Neumann and group C*-algebras
claims.evidence: The carrier, product Haar measure, and Gamma action are shift-independent; Fourier transform identifies the common crossed products.

claims.name: The ternary candidate groups are mutually commensurable
claims.evidence: The shift-forgetting quotient dualizes to G_0 inside G_n with index 3^(3n), conditional on the compact-dual construction.

claims.name: The proposed semidirect products have property (T)
claims.evidence: A joint 1/8 invariant-measure escape bound contradicts the Cornulier-Tessera failure sequence after property-(T) invariantization.

claims.name: Primitive boxes and affine charts cover every prime in rank at least three
claims.evidence: Primitive boxes have c_prim>0 exactly when (p-1)p^(r-3)>1; a degree-p polynomial is nonzero on at least r-p charts. Six exact restriction-rank cases pass, and the focused Lean target checks the resulting constants.

claims.name: The minimal-rank line r_p=max(p,3) supports a uniform prime carry family
claims.evidence: Cyclicity, orbit growth, detector positivity, Witt carries, Bockstein recovery, and common crossed products align with intrinsic cardinal p^(r_p n). General formalization and independent review remain.

claims.name: The binary construction may not need its torsion-free acting-group detour
claims.evidence: SL_4(F_2[t]) has trivial amenable radical, so the abelian layer is characteristic. The published orbit extension gives ICC directly and its 1/7 pointed-space detector gives relative property (T), making the auxiliary lift and factor transfer for group properties optional.

claims.name: Completed prime-uniform property-(T) counterexample families
claims.evidence: The binary architecture is published elsewhere. The minimal-rank prime synthesis has paper proof candidates, but key interfaces remain unformalized and no independent expert review has occurred.
